name: ElevatedCircle
description: Circular container for icons and status glyphs. Uses clip-path for a perfect circle, configurable diameter, and inset box-shadow variants. Optional props default to legacy behavior so existing usages keep working without changes.

children.description: Content rendered inside the circle (typically an icon)

size.description: Circle diameter. Numbers are treated as pixels (e.g. 128 → 128px). Strings may include units (e.g. '10rem'). Legacy default is 128.

shadowVariant.description: Box-shadow style. `normal` is the legacy soft inset glow (`inset 0 0 5px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5)`). `inset` is a softer directional inset (`inset 2px 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25)`). `none` removes the box-shadow entirely.

advanced.title: Legacy usage (unchanged)
advanced.description: Omitting size and shadowVariant keeps the previous 128px diameter and normal shadow.

advanced.title: Custom size with inset shadow
advanced.description: Smaller circle with the new inset shadow variant.

cssVariables.name: --elevated-circle-size
cssVariables.description: Diameter applied to width and height

accessibility.notes: Decorative container; ensure child icons have appropriate aria labels when they convey meaning.

notes: Shape uses clip-path: circle(50%) instead of border-radius for a true circle.
Defaults (size=128, shadowVariant='normal') preserve legacy visual behavior.
Shadow variants: `normal` (legacy glow), `inset` (softer directional inset), `none` (no shadow).
ALWAYS wrap usage that expects page spacing with elevated-circle-container when following error/success page patterns.

Theme opt-in: styles.iconContainerBackground (default transparent) is exposed as view.iconContainerBackground for the container background — does not change icon SVG colors. Pass manually when desired.
